title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
authors_zh: Jin Xu 等 14 位作者
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态模型技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要核查多模态预训练、语音偏好优化和数据披露边界的读者
one_line: Qwen2.5-Omni discloses multimodal pre-training categories and Phase-2 token totals, ChatML instruction-data modalities, and a WER/punctuation-ranked Talker DPO interface, but not the underlying records, reward implementation, sources, or audit artifacts.
Qwen2.5-Omni 披露了多模态预训练类别及第二阶段 token 总量、ChatML 指令数据的模态构成，以及以 WER/标点停顿误差排序的 Talker DPO 接口；但未公开底层记录、奖励实现、数据来源或审计工件。
why: It makes a useful Track 12 disclosure comparison: a frontier release can identify modality mixtures and a pairwise speech-feedback interface while still withholding the source, construction, and validation evidence needed to reproduce or audit it.
inclusion_reason: Frontier multimodal technical report that discloses modality-level pre-training totals, ChatML instruction data types, and a WER/punctuation-ranked DPO interface while leaving source, reward, and audit details incomplete.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can disclose training-stage names or aggregate token counts while omitting the evidence required to audit their data objects. For a multimodal model, readers need to distinguish a category label such as “audio-text” or “mixed-modality conversation” from a source manifest, a released record, a filtering decision, and a rights or contamination audit.

Qwen2.5-Omni is useful for this question because its technical report makes several concrete post-training disclosures: ChatML instruction data spans text, visual, audio, and mixed-modality conversations, and the Talker uses a DPO-style preference tuple ranked with WER- and punctuation-pause-associated scores. It does not release those records or the full construction and audit evidence, so this Card records a disclosure boundary rather than a reusable recipe.

前沿模型报告可能披露训练阶段名称或汇总 token 数量，却没有提供审计其数据对象所需的证据。对于多模态模型，读者需要将“audio-text”或“mixed-modality conversation”这类类别标签，与来源清单、已发布记录、过滤决策、权利说明和污染审计区分开来。

Qwen2.5-Omni 对这一问题具有参考价值，因为其技术报告作出了一些具体的后训练披露：ChatML 指令数据涵盖文本、视觉、音频和混合模态对话；Talker 使用以 WER 与标点停顿误差相关分数排序的 DPO 式偏好元组。报告没有发布这些记录，也没有提供完整的构建和审计证据，因此本 Card 记录的是披露边界，而不是可复用配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official report presents Qwen2.5-Omni as an end-to-end system for text, image, audio, and video input with streaming text and speech output. Its Thinker produces text, while its Talker consumes Thinker hidden representations to produce audio tokens. This architecture matters here only because the report links it to a staged multimodal data and feedback narrative.

For pre-training, the report names image-text, video-text, video-audio, audio-text, and text corpora. It gives Phase-2 totals of 800B image/video, 300B audio, and 100B video-with-audio tokens. For post-training, Thinker uses ChatML instruction-finetuning data across four modality groupings. Talker has context-continuation, DPO, and multi-speaker instruction-finetuning stages; its disclosed DPO tuple is input text, good and bad generated speech, and reference speech, with ranking based on scores associated with WER and punctuation-pause error.

No underlying training, instruction, reference-speech, preference, or rejected-output records are released in these sources.

官方报告将 Qwen2.5-Omni 描述为一个可接收文本、图像、音频和视频输入，并流式输出文本和语音的端到端系统。其 Thinker 生成文本，Talker 使用 Thinker 的隐藏表示生成音频 token。该架构在此处仅作为语境，因为报告将其与分阶段的多模态数据和反馈叙述相联系。

在预训练方面，报告列出 image-text、video-text、video-audio、audio-text 和文本语料，并给出第二阶段 800B image/video、300B audio 和 100B video-with-audio token 的总量。在后训练方面，Thinker 使用覆盖四类模态组合的 ChatML 指令微调数据。Talker 包含上下文续写、DPO 和多说话人指令微调阶段；其被披露的 DPO 元组由输入文本、好的与坏的生成语音及参考语音构成，并按与 WER 和标点停顿误差相关的分数排序。

这些来源没有发布底层训练、指令、参考语音、偏好或拒绝输出记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report describes three pre-training stages. It first locks the LLM while training vision and audio encoders, then unfreezes all parameters for wider multimodal training, and finally trains with 32k-sequence data. It says the LLM is initialized from Qwen2.5, the vision encoder from Qwen2.5-VL, and the audio encoder from Whisper-large-v3. It reports a maximum length of 8,192 in earlier stages and 32,768 in the final stage. Source names, mixture weights, item schemas, licences, and filtering procedures are not supplied.

For Thinker, the report says ChatML instruction-finetuning includes pure-text dialogue, visual-modality conversation, audio-modality conversation, and mixed-modality conversation. The displayed format shows a user multimodal context and an assistant response, but not data origin, prompt construction, counts, filters, or release location.

For Talker, the report names context continuation, DPO, and multi-speaker instruction fine-tuning. It states that a DPO dataset contains input text x, good and bad generated speech y_w and y_l, and reference speech; samples are ranked with reward scores associated with word error rate and punctuation-pause error. The objective is shown, but the reward computation, pair-generation model, reference-speech provenance, score weights, thresholds, calibration, pair count, decoding settings, and retention yield are unknown.

报告描述了三个预训练阶段：先锁定 LLM 并训练视觉和音频编码器，之后解冻全部参数以进行更广泛的多模态训练，最后使用 32k 序列数据训练。报告称 LLM 由 Qwen2.5 初始化，视觉编码器由 Qwen2.5-VL 初始化，音频编码器由 Whisper-large-v3 初始化；前序阶段最大长度为 8,192，最后阶段为 32,768。来源名称、混合权重、样本结构、许可和过滤过程均未提供。

对于 Thinker，报告称 ChatML 指令微调包含纯文本对话、视觉模态对话、音频模态对话和混合模态对话。示例格式展示了带有多模态上下文的用户输入及助手响应，但没有数据来源、提示词构建、数量、过滤方式或发布位置。

对于 Talker，报告列出上下文续写、DPO 和多说话人指令微调。其称 DPO 数据集包含输入文本 x、好的与坏的生成语音 y_w 和 y_l，以及参考语音；样本按与词错误率和标点停顿误差相关的奖励分数排序。报告给出了目标函数，但奖励计算、生成候选对的模型、参考语音来源、分数权重、阈值、校准、对数、解码设置和保留率均为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The primary technical report supports the modality categories, the Phase-2 800B/300B/100B totals, the three pre-training-stage outline, the four Thinker instruction-data groupings, and the three named Talker stages. It also explicitly gives the DPO tuple variables and states that samples are ranked using reward scores associated with WER and punctuation-pause error. The official Qwen repository links the report, release blog, code, and official model page; the repository itself declares Apache-2.0.

These are disclosures from the authors, not independently reproduced data-pipeline results. The report contains extensive benchmark results, but those results do not establish the provenance of the training data, the correctness of a preference pair, the validity or calibration of the reward scores, or resistance to contamination. Public weights and code similarly do not make the reported data assets public.

一手技术报告支持以下内容：模态类别、第二阶段 800B/300B/100B 总量、三个预训练阶段的概述、四类 Thinker 指令数据组合，以及 Talker 的三个命名阶段。报告还明确给出了 DPO 元组变量，并称样本按与 WER 和标点停顿误差相关的奖励分数排序。官方 Qwen 仓库链接了该报告、发布博客、代码和官方模型页；仓库本身声明为 Apache-2.0。

这些是作者的披露，而不是经独立复现的数据流水线结果。报告包含大量基准测试结果，但这些结果不能证明训练数据的来源、偏好对的正确性、奖励分数的有效性或校准，也不能证明其具备抗污染能力。公开权重和代码同样不等于公开了报告中使用的数据资产。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a standalone data release. Its value for the disclosure ledger is the combination of a moderately specific multimodal pre-training description with an explicit post-training speech-preference interface. The report moves beyond a generic “we used instruction tuning” statement by naming the Thinker modality groups and a Talker tuple containing a reference speech item and preferred/dispreferred generated speech, together with two stated ranking signals.

The useful contribution is comparative, not reproducibility. The same report leaves the decisive construction details unknown: source corpus identity and rights, record-level schemas, pair generation, score computation, quality-control thresholds, data quantities after pre-training, splits, and audit results.

这不是一个独立的数据发布。它对披露台账的价值，在于将中等具体程度的多模态预训练描述，与明确的后训练语音偏好接口结合起来。报告并非仅笼统地说“使用了指令微调”，而是指出了 Thinker 的模态分组，以及一个包含参考语音、偏好/非偏好生成语音的 Talker 元组，并给出了两个排序信号。

其有用贡献在于可比较性，而不在于可复现性。同一报告仍将关键构建细节保留为 unknown：源语料身份和权利、记录级结构、样本对生成、分数计算、质控阈值、预训练之后的数据数量、数据划分和审计结果。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not release the pre-training corpora, Thinker instruction records, reference-speech data, DPO preference records, rejected outputs, source manifests, or a complete record schema. The Phase-2 token totals do not identify source composition or provenance, and the repository’s Apache-2.0 licence should not be interpreted as a licence for unreleased training data.

The Talker feedback contract cannot be independently audited. WER and punctuation-pause error are named as score-associated signals, but their exact calculation, weights, aggregation, thresholds, candidate-generation process, calibration, false-ranking rates, and human validation are not reported. Splits and decontamination are also not reported.

The report itself notes that label noise and pronunciation errors in pre-training data can lead to hallucinations. It does not quantify this risk or disclose whether the preference construction eliminates it. Therefore, the Card remains a partial report-level disclosure record.

报告没有发布预训练语料、Thinker 指令记录、参考语音数据、DPO 偏好记录、拒绝输出、来源清单或完整的记录结构。第二阶段 token 总量无法说明来源组成或数据谱系；仓库的 Apache-2.0 许可也不应被解释为未发布训练数据的许可。

Talker 的反馈约定无法被独立审计。报告将 WER 和标点停顿误差列为与评分相关的信号，却没有披露其精确计算、权重、聚合方式、阈值、候选生成过程、校准、错误排序率或人工验证。数据划分和去污染也没有报告。

报告自身指出预训练数据中的标签噪声和发音错误可能导致幻觉，但没有量化这种风险，也没有说明偏好构建是否消除了它。因此，本 Card 仍只是部分的报告级披露记录。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, Qwen2.5-Omni supplies a compact comparison point for multimodal disclosure. A curator can record what is actually named: modality-level pre-training categories and selected totals, Thinker instruction-data modality groups, a DPO tuple shape, and WER/punctuation-pause-associated ranking. The same record must preserve that sources, records, score implementation, and audit controls are unknown.

It is relevant to post-training reasoning-data work because it shows an answer-level, pairwise speech-feedback interface rather than merely model output performance. It can inform questions about how speech data or preference pairs are constructed, but it must not be used as evidence that a released DPO dataset, reward model, or reproducible multimodal training recipe exists.

对 Track 12 而言，Qwen2.5-Omni 提供了一个紧凑的多模态披露比较点。策展者可以记录其中实际被点明的内容：模态级预训练类别及部分总量、Thinker 指令数据的模态分组、DPO 元组结构，以及与 WER/标点停顿相关的排序信号。同时，这一记录必须保留数据来源、记录本身、评分实现和审计控制仍为 unknown 的事实。

它与后训练推理数据相关，是因为其展示了一个答案级、成对的语音反馈接口，而不只是模型输出性能。它可以帮助提出语音数据或偏好对如何构建的问题，但不能被当作已发布 DPO 数据集、奖励模型或可复现多模态训练配方存在的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the 800B image/video, 300B audio, and 100B video-with-audio figures as aggregate Phase-2 disclosures, not source manifests or data releases.
  • Separate the disclosed Talker tuple and WER/punctuation-pause ranking signals from the unreported reward formula, candidate generator, thresholds, and calibration.
  • Treat the displayed ChatML examples as format evidence only; they do not establish source, licence, count, or filtering details for Thinker data.
  • Do not extend the Apache-2.0 repository licence to pre-training, instruction, reference-speech, or preference data.

• 将 800B image/video、300B audio 和 100B video-with-audio 视为第二阶段的汇总披露，而不是来源清单或数据发布。
  • 将披露的 Talker 元组及 WER/标点停顿排序信号，与未披露的奖励公式、候选生成器、阈值和校准区分开来。
  • 将展示的 ChatML 示例仅视为格式证据；它们不能证明 Thinker 数据的来源、许可、数量或过滤细节。
  • 不要将 Apache-2.0 仓库许可延伸解释为预训练、指令、参考语音或偏好数据的许可。
